items: capture-render-quality-v1 items 2+3 A/B: Depth Anything V2 Small prior + DN-Splatter-style depth/normal losses
authorised_by: parent turn 3 (run the depth-prior A/B now; defer antialiased+default single-factor arm; keep ~$4 of October Modal free; hard stop if October passes $16.50)

arms.baseline: antialiased-default: the shipping recipe (quality-30k, antialiased, default densification) at the 400K display budget
arms.dn: antialiased-default-dn: same + depth_prior=depth-anything-v2-small (Pearson inverse-depth x0.2, depth-normal consistency x0.1, normal TV x0.05, from step 500)

rooms.why_two: No antialiased-default 400K corpus baseline exists on the volume, so each room needs 2 runs. 4 rooms x 2 = 8 runs (~$5.0) would end October near $17.2 > $16.50. Picked the two indoor rooms closest to a bedroom.
rooms.bedroom_owner_room_01: dn arm only (AUTH #046, private; metrics only in the repo); baseline = M1-PIPE-02 quality-30k-400k antialiased-default on the same 29 held-out views (24.85 / 0.942 / 0.124, Unity path 21.71 dB)

metrics: held-out PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS (every 8th frame), floater proxy (isolated/giant/needle share, extent-scaled thresholds, see item1-ab-results.json), bedroom also through tools.unity_path_eval; RGB | inverse depth | depth-normal panels for 3 held-out views per corpus run (ns_finish --geometry-renders)
decision_rule: Pre-registered (floaters/geometry first, per parent): flip ReconstructionConfig.depth_prior default to 'depth-anything-v2-small' only if, on EVERY evaluated room (2 corpus + bedroom), the dn arm lowers the floater proxy AND does not worsen LPIPS by more than +0.005, AND the mean PSNR change is >= -0.3 dB. Geometry panels are a sanity check, not a gate. With 2 of 4 corpus rooms the flip would be provisional pending Umayyad/Paranal.

cost_estimate_usd.basis: item-1 actual: $5.28 metered for 9 runs = $0.59/run; dn adds ~1 min prior inference + 5-10% training

budget_check.hard_stop: watchdog stops both apps at metered >= $16.50 or container-time estimate >= $3.90
